listingTitle: NSdirect Round Coffee Table,36" Coffee Table for Living Room,2-Tier Rustic Wood Desktop with Storage Shelf Modern Design Home Furniture(Light Walnut)
listingLines: [Design & Dimensions]This coffee table features a two-tier design. The top tier is a round surface measuring 36 inches in diameter. The lower tier is a bottom shelf measuring 33.5 inches in diameter, providing secondary storage space.

[Materials & Construction]The tabletop of the coffee tables is constructed from P2 environmental grade medium-density fiberboard (MDF) with a walnut wood grain veneer finish. The finish is processed for water resistance and wear resistance. The legs are made of matte alloy material, providing support for the table structure.
[Finish & Style]The round coffee table has a circular shape with a walnut wood grain veneer surface and metal legs. Its design allows it to blend with various interior decor styles.
[Assembly & Care]This product requires customer assembly. All necessary tools and a step-by-step instruction manual are included within the packaging. For cleaning, use a soft, dry cloth.

[Warranty & Support]A 3-year limited warranty is provided from the date of purchase. Warranty terms and coverage are detailed in the included warranty documentation. For any product issues, contact the seller directly through Amazon Seller Messaging.
